title.narrative: Improved timeliness in the initiation of treatment for breast cancer

comment.narrative:
End-of-Project Target Achieved.
The indicator measures the time elapsed (in number of days) between the first histopathologic diagnostic report and the first treatment (chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or surgery) for women diagnosed with breast cancer who had initiated treatment. The value reported as of Dec 2022 (Previous value) was a preliminary measure informed by the MSPS during the September 2024 supervision mission. The value reported as of Jan 1st, 2023 (Current value) for the (period January 2, 2022- January 1, 2023 is based on audited data reported by EPSs to the CCA (Cuenta de Alto Costo) and published in: https://cuentadealtocosto.org/wp-content/upload3535s/2024/12/situacion-del-cancer-en-la-poblacion-adulta-de-colombia-2023-3.pdf. The MSPS has a delay of 24 months to process the information gathered from the data source.

title.narrative: Improved timeliness in the initiation of treatment for breast cancer

comment.narrative:
End-of-Project Target Surpassed.
The indicator measures the time elapsed (in number of days) between the first histopathologic diagnostic report and the first treatment (chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or surgery) for women diagnosed with breast cancer who had initiated treatment. The value reported as of Jan 1st, 2023 (current value) for the period January 2, 2022- January 1, 2023 is based on audited data reported by EPSs to the CCA (Cuenta de Alto Costo), and can be found here: https://cuentadealtocosto.org/wp-content/upload3535s/2024/12/situacion-del-cancer-en-la-poblacion-adulta-de-colombia-2023-3.pdf. The MSPS has a delay of 24 months to process the information gathered from the data source. During the mission the MSPS promised to send the preliminary data for 2023. The Bank and the MSPS will keep tracking that the time between diagnostic and initiation of treatment stays below 45 days as per international standards

In 2024, 82,938 migrants were reached, meeting 64.4% of the goal set for that year. Resources are needed to continue advancing with this indicator but the grant funds from the Global Fund to Fight Against AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria are pending the government's countersignature of the restructuring. title.narrative: Percentage of citizen consultations and claims submitted through the internet site of the MSPS solved on time according to resolution 3687 of 2016 (PQRSD)

comment.narrative: The percentage is close to baseline, but recovering from the 72% reported in December 2024. Two factors explain the drop: (i) in May 2024 the MSPS started a new system to monitor this, requiring a learning process to adjust, and (ii) in the second half of 2024 there was an increase in the number of requests received on the MSPS's website.

title.narrative: Women victims of sexual violence who receive mental health services

comment.narrative: While progress of close to 90 per cent was reported in previous missions, it was identified that such progress did not meet the operational definition set out in the Program documents. The current value follows the agreed technical guidelines, which consider only health care provided from a selection of CUPS codes. The data presented is preliminary. The corresponding value for December 2024 is 34.6%.

title.narrative: Percentage of Territorial Entities that adopted a Climate Change Adaptation Plan with a One Health approach

comment.narrative: During February 2025 supervision mission, it was agreed that the MSPS will prepare an action plan to achieve the end-target.

title.narrative: Percentage of Territorial Entities that adopted a Climate Change Adaptation Plan with a One Health approach

comment.narrative: During the September 2025 supervision mission, the MSPS presented the action plan to achieve the end-target. Progress was reported in the 8 out of 11 prioritized departments including Atlántico, Santander, Nariño, Putumayo, Magdalena, Casanare, La Guajira y Guaviare. Plans are expected to be submitted for MSPss legal review by end of calendar year. The target of 30 percent refers to 11 prioritized departments out of 36 departments. The baseline refers to 3 out of 11 prioritized departments.
